goal: Native front/rear Linux drivers and libcamera IPA with independently measured tuning and upstream interfaces.

implementation.prepared_format: Semantic R/G/B, 256 little-endian base12/signed12-delta words per channel; encoding revalidated after owned copy.
implementation.ownership: Owned gamma copy and private profile-derived capsule. Existing provider obtains its independent copy before both temporaries are explicitly erased and freed.
implementation.frame_identity: Existing validated scalar packet request ID and bank parity, including inverse GTM/Gamma banks; unchanged provider FIFO identity/depth enforcement.
implementation.sections: Actual capsule descriptor validation and named gamma payload lookup; all three bounds, sizes, identities and disjointness validated before gamma destination mutation.
implementation.source_channel_binding: Semantic G/B/R to retained payload0/1/2, matching existing gamma selector1/2/3 topology and v41x proposal names.

qualification.failure_cases: Late malformed gamma, truncation, missing profile, disabled/ineligible/pinned/worker state, allocation failures, profile load failure, malformed/overlapping/duplicate/missing destinations, provider depth/identity rejection.
qualification.success_cases: Three distinct mathematical channel curves mapped as G/B/R, correct request/banks, all other bytes preserved, baseline/input unchanged, queued capsule immutable after caller buffer overwrite, scalar-only tables preserved.

upstream.state: Proposed; not claimed merged or SP11-hardware qualified.
upstream.next: Standard metadata params transport and libcamera/IPA producer, with format negotiation and stream/request ownership. No private scalar packet enlargement.
